I have a few criticisms:

  1. As seen here, the new design doesn't render correctly on vertical monitors.
  2. The dark blue, thick outline around the posts stands out too much. Perhaps a less contrasted color will do better.
  3. On the main page, the design isolates the posts too much and separates the posts from the rest of the page; it feels claustrophobic. I think it'll work better if you can instead draw the outline around each post link individually and extend the outline all the way to the other end of the page to add some needed whitespace inside the boxes.
  4. The color palette is awkward. I'm not sure the faded, blue-gray background and blue outlines and shading match the theme of Terraria. It looks kind of retro, like Windows 95.
  5. The Terraria logo at the top of the page is too big. It's taking up a lot of space that could be used for more posts and comments.

Edit: I'm not sure adding "Introduction and Rules" and "Rules will follow" to every post is a good idea. ;) It's better if you just stick to basic formatting in the sidebar for now.

/* Post List */
.link {
 background-color: white;
 border: 1px solid #D9C0C0;
 }
